about: Steps an agent follows before a resume, CV, cover letter or written answer is considered ready for the candidate to submit.
steps: Start from the brief (`node app/cli.mjs op run brief.get --input '{"applicationId":"ID"}'`). Apply active writing rules within their scope; treat proposed rules as suggestions to raise with the candidate.
Re-open the live employer posting and record when it was checked. Note the deadline, required fields and word limits, or say they were not inspected.
Build a short qualification-to-evidence map and list the gaps explicitly.
Ask the candidate targeted questions for missing facts (dates, authorship, metric period) and save the answers in the career library.
Generate the document from the format files in '3 Templates' and change only what the role needs. Record each change and its reason.
Run an independent review pass (a second agent or a fresh read) for factual scope, attribution, chronology, fit and layout. Apply optional suggestions only if they add no claim.
Export the PDF and look at every page: clipping, overlaps, missing characters, a heading stranded at the bottom of a page, role/date collisions, page count.
Check text and structure: no {{placeholders}} left, no claims carried over from an example, fonts as set in the format file, contact details identical across documents, word count within limits.
Save the result as a new material version in the career library. Earlier versions are never overwritten.

Give it to the candidate for a final read. Submission then follows their saved submission mode (see app/skills/submit-application.md); afterwards record exactly what was filed, including every question and answer, with the `submissions.record` operation.
